_comment: Copy to ~/.hermes/zeus/watchdog.config.json and edit. All keys are optional; omit any to keep the default. Paths default under $HERMES_HOME (~/.hermes). The bot token defaults to reading TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN from ~/.hermes/.env; set bot_token inline only if you must.
_heartbeat_note: Must exceed the slowest executor's heartbeat cadence. ACP/claude-code workers heartbeat ~hourly, so keep this >= 7200 (2h) unless you run only fast-heartbeat hermes-workers.
